# AEGIS / HATHOR Business Docs

> Business-facing interpretation and guidance for HATHOR/AEGIS.

## Canon
- [AEGIS-CANON-006 — AEGIS Business Documentation](./INDEX.md): This documentation explains the business problem AEGIS is intended to solve, the value it is expected to create, the capabilities and operating model required to create that value, the controls that bound its use, and...

## Guides
- [AEGIS-GUIDE-003 — AEGIS Executive Overview](./01-executive-overview.md): AEGIS is a proposed agentic governance platform for organizations that want people and AI agents to work at machine speed without giving up authorization, accountability, evidence, or human control.
- [AEGIS-GUIDE-004 — AEGIS Business Requirements](./02-business-requirements.md): OBJ-*` and `BIZ-*` labels are local traceability aids for this derived document. They do not add canonical AEGIS requirements or amend `AEGIS-CANON-001`.

- [AEGIS-GUIDE-006 — AEGIS Target Operating Model](./04-operating-model.md): The target operating model is based on the following source-grounded rules:
- [AEGIS-GUIDE-007 — AEGIS Governance, Risk, and Controls](./05-governance-risk-and-controls.md): AEGIS is intended to let an organization increase the speed and volume of delegated work without weakening:
- [AEGIS-GUIDE-008 — AEGIS Adoption Roadmap](./06-adoption-roadmap.md): Move from design to measurable, governed use without treating feature completion as operational readiness or business value.
- [AEGIS-GUIDE-009 — AEGIS Value and Success Measures](./07-value-and-success-measures.md): CTL-*` and `VAL-*` labels are local measurement aids. They do not add canonical AEGIS identifiers or alter source acceptance criteria.
- [AEGIS-GUIDE-010 — AEGIS Business Glossary and Source Register](./08-glossary-and-source-register.md): 1. [`AEGIS-CANON-001`](../architect/aegis-canon-001-registries-20260913.md) is the authority for enumerated gates, events, refusal codes, linters, bot roster, and identifiers.
